subject.title: [Bug]: WebChat can render assistant reply before user prompt and duplicate inbound messages

question: Should maintainers continue #80670, or a clean successor, as the canonical fix path for this WebChat user-turn persistence and duplicate-context issue?
rationale: The remaining work spans WebChat rendering, Gateway chat.send ACK timing, and session transcript/context assembly, and an open implementation candidate already exists with a blocking review finding.

options.title: Review or Port #80670
options.body: Use #80670 or a clean successor as the canonical path, porting it through the current shared recorder/session-accessor boundary and proving the busy same-session case.

options.title: Hold For Fresh Repro
options.body: Keep the issue open as needs-info and request fresh current-main WebChat proof before authorizing more code work.

options.title: Retarget To Narrow Tracker
options.body: Close or pause #80670 only if maintainers create a narrower canonical tracker that preserves the same WebChat user-turn durability requirements.

recommendation.title: Review or Port #80670
recommendation.body: Use #80670 or a clean successor as the canonical path, porting it through the current shared recorder/session-accessor boundary and proving the busy same-session case.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is centered on Gateway transcript/session-accessor ownership, where recent history points to jalehman as the closest current contributor.
